documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our regional logistics team struggles with approval delays. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's specific operational friction is 'approval delays' in their regional logistics team. They explicitly stated a need for 'workflow coordination and account reporting' and requested a discovery meeting to understand their requirements. However, they also noted that 'no budget has been approved,' which creates uncertainty around the financial commitment.

claims.quote: Our regional logistics team struggles with approval delays.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your regional logistics team is facing approval delays, and you're seeking workflow coordination and account reporting to address this. We'd be happy to schedule a discovery meeting to better understand your specific requirements and how Cedar Systems can support your needs. Please let us know a convenient time to proceed.
questions: What is the current status of your internal approval process for new systems?
Are there any specific departments or stakeholders involved in the approval delays?
What are your expectations for the workflow coordination and account reporting features in terms of integration and reporting frequency?
uncertainties: No budget has been approved, which may impact the timeline or scope of the project.
